_readme: Data for the Visual codes for video page. 'prompt' is the exact text that was sent with the start image (code + any added sentence) — the page shows it and the copy button hands it over, so it must never be edited by hand. 'slug' names the media files in media/: <slug>.mp4, <slug>-poster.webp, <slug>-start.webp, built by scripts/build-video-codes-media.py from 'source_clip' and 'source_start' (files in the test folder outside the repo). status: works | partial | fails ('fails' only in the doesnt-work-yet section).

sections.title: See the invisible
sections.intro: Too slow, too fast, too small or hidden inside: motion shows what a single picture cannot.

codes.prompt: /timelapse
codes.description: Compresses a slow process into seconds — growth, decay, a moving shadow.

codes.prompt: /slowmotion A single drop falls into the water and makes a splash.
codes.description: Stretches a split second so the class can actually see it happen.
codes.note: Needs an event in the picture: on a still glass of water the code had nothing to slow down. Compare the result with real high-speed footage — the drop behaves more like a glass bead than water.

codes.prompt: /xray
codes.description: Turns the outer shell see-through while the machine keeps working.

codes.prompt: /explodedview
codes.description: Pulls the parts apart in mid-air so every component and its place become visible.

codes.prompt: /zoomscale One continuous zoom into the leaf, down to its cells and chloroplasts.
codes.description: One unbroken zoom from the visible world down to the microscopic.
codes.note: Convincing — and wrong: plant cells are boxy with cell walls, not floating green spheres. Ask the class what the model got wrong.

codes.prompt: /earthzoomout
codes.description: Pulls back from a single place until the whole planet is in view.
codes.note: The valley looks Alpine, but the globe the camera arrives at shows India. Where should it have ended?

codes.prompt: /phasechange The temperature rises steadily throughout the clip.
codes.description: Shows matter changing state as the temperature rises.
codes.note: The ice shrinks, but no puddle grows and no steam appears. Where did the water go?

codes.prompt: /particleview Show the water molecules moving faster as the burner heats the beaker.
codes.description: Meant to reveal moving molecules — a model of matter at particle scale.
codes.note: No molecules appear. Instead the water boils in a beaker that is not even on the burner — a ready-made physics question.

sections.title: Processes and change over time
sections.intro: Cycles, sequences and slow transformations: content that is change gets clearer when it moves.

codes.prompt: /seasons The camera stays still while a full year passes.
codes.description: Runs a full year through one fixed view — summer, autumn, winter, spring.

codes.prompt: /lifecycle
codes.description: Plays out a whole life cycle, from beginning to end.
codes.note: Arrives as a short montage with cuts. Check species and stages before you show it.

codes.prompt: /flowtrace Follow one drop of water from the roots up through the trunk to a leaf.
codes.description: Follows one particle through a system, from start to finish.
codes.note: The trunk turns into red, blood-vessel-like tubes. Trees do not work like that — let the class explain why.

codes.prompt: /reconstruct The ruin rebuilds itself into the complete castle as it looked when it was new.
codes.description: Rebuilds a ruin to how it may once have looked.
codes.note: The model invents a flag on the tower. How would we know what really flew there? Source criticism in five seconds.

codes.prompt: /assemblysequence The loose parts fly in and join, step by step, until the chair is complete.
codes.description: Puts the parts together in order, step by step.

codes.prompt: /throughtime Decades pass: the pond fills in, grows over and becomes a forest.
codes.description: Compresses decades of change in one place into a single clip.

codes.prompt: /oxidize Days pass in seconds.
codes.description: Makes a slow chemical reaction visible — the cut apple browns.
codes.note: The nail does not rust. Realistic over a few days — a good question for the class.

sections.title: Film language for art class
sections.intro: Light, focus, colour and style change how a picture feels. Each code isolates one tool from the film-maker's kit.

codes.prompt: /lightshift The same scene goes from midday to sunset to night.
codes.description: Keeps the scene and changes the light — and with it the whole mood.

codes.prompt: /paintingalive Subtle, natural movement only. Keep the painted style.
codes.description: Brings a public-domain painting gently to life while keeping the brushwork.
codes.note: Vermeer, The Milkmaid (c. 1658), Rijksmuseum — public domain. Use only paintings old enough to be out of copyright.

codes.prompt: /selectivecolor Everything except the red umbrella slowly loses its color.
codes.description: Drains the colour from everything except one object, so colour itself carries the meaning.
codes.note: The umbrella stays red, but the colour drains almost at once instead of evenly over the clip.

codes.prompt: /matchcut The eye turns into the planet Earth.
codes.description: Turns one shape into another that looks alike — a visual rhyme.

codes.prompt: /tiltshift
codes.description: Turns a real place into what looks like a miniature model — focus that changes scale.

codes.prompt: /rackfocus Focus shifts from the butterfly to the red flowers in the background.
codes.description: Moves the focus from one subject to another and steers where we look.
codes.note: Needs a start image with shallow depth of field. On a photo that is sharp front to back there was nothing to shift.

codes.prompt: /stopmotion Animated frame by frame: the clock hands jump in small, jerky steps.
codes.description: Animates frame by frame, the way stop-motion films are made.

codes.prompt: /noir Black and white film noir: hard light and deep shadows.
codes.description: Recasts the scene as film noir: black and white, hard light, deep shadows.

codes.prompt: /dutchangle The camera slowly tilts until the horizon is crooked.
codes.description: Tilts the horizon until the picture feels uneasy.

codes.prompt: /flythrough The camera flies in through the front door and on through the rooms.
codes.description: Moves the camera into the scene, so the movement itself tells the story.

codes.prompt: /sketchtolife The drawing comes alive and moves, still in the same crayon style.
codes.description: Lets a drawing come alive without losing its style.
codes.note: Subtle: the cat and the sun move a little. Try it on a pupil's own drawing.

sections.title: Tested — doesn't work (yet)
sections.intro: We tested each of these, most of them several times and with added sentences. Moving a camera through space or stopping time is beyond the model when it starts from a single still image — even when we supplied the end image as well. /silhouette never turned the figure into a dark shape, and /reverse never looked real. For art class that is a lesson in itself: AI can imitate a film crew, but it has no camera to move.

codes.prompt: /dollyzoom The chair stays the same size while the corridor behind it stretches away.
codes.description: Hitchcock's vertigo effect: the subject stays put while the background stretches.
codes.note: The chair shrinks — the camera simply moves back.

codes.prompt: /lowangle The camera sinks to the ground and looks up at the runner.
codes.description: A low angle that makes the subject look powerful.
codes.note: The camera sinks to the runner's legs but never looks up.

codes.prompt: /orbit The camera flies all the way around the castle and back to the start.
codes.description: The camera circles the subject to show its shape.
codes.note: Never more than a short arc in three attempts.

codes.prompt: /bullettime Freeze the moment: the player and the ball hang motionless in mid-air while the camera slowly circles.
codes.description: Time stops while the camera sweeps around the frozen moment.
codes.note: The moment never freezes — the shot simply carries on.

codes.prompt: /freezeframe Freeze at the moment the ball leaves the hands.
codes.description: Stops the action mid-movement.
codes.note: No freeze — the camera zooms in on the player instead.

codes.prompt: /silhouette The light moves behind the person.
codes.description: Backlight that turns a figure into a dark shape.
codes.note: A rim of light appears, but the person never becomes a silhouette.

codes.prompt: /reverse Play what happened backwards in time.
codes.description: Runs an event backwards — meant to raise the question of why some processes only go one way.
codes.note: Three motifs — pancakes, a broken glass, a row of dominoes — and none looked real. The last clip ends as a mix of dice and dominoes.

sections.title: Beyond the classroom
sections.intro: Not every code needs a lesson plan. These are useful for family photos, travel pictures, a small business or social media.

codes.prompt: /oldphotoalive Gentle, natural movement only. No talking.
codes.description: Gives an old family photo gentle, natural movement.
codes.note: Ask the family first — and never make people in old photos speak.

codes.prompt: /turntable The product rotates 360 degrees on a turntable. Nothing else changes.
codes.description: Spins a product so it is seen from every side.
codes.note: Use one object that is not round: on a round thermos the rotation was invisible, and several small objects just moved around.

codes.prompt: /staging Furniture appears piece by piece.
codes.description: Furnishes an empty room, piece by piece.
codes.note: If you use it to sell or rent a home, say that the furnishing is AI-generated.

codes.prompt: /unboxing
codes.description: Opens the box and reveals what is inside.

codes.prompt: /crashzoom
codes.description: A sudden, fast zoom — the comic punchline of social media video.

codes.prompt: /cinemagraph Only the clouds move. Everything else stays still.
codes.description: A still photo where only one thing moves — made for loops.

codes.prompt: /dronereveal
codes.description: The camera rises and reveals how big the place really is.

codes.prompt: /fpv Fast, swooping drone flight low over the ground and up the slope toward the crater.
codes.description: A fast, low drone flight through the landscape.

codes.prompt: /watercolor The whole scene turns into a moving watercolor painting with soft washes and visible paper texture.
codes.description: Turns the photo into a moving watercolour painting.

codes.prompt: /parallax Slide the camera sideways so the foreground and the background move at different speeds.
codes.description: Makes a flat photo feel three-dimensional.
codes.note: The background slides past — but the cow glides along without walking.

codes.prompt: /vhs Make it look like it was filmed on a 1980s VHS camcorder: soft picture, color bleed and scan lines.
codes.description: A retro home-video look.
codes.note: The picture gets softer, but no scan lines or colour bleed appear.

codes.prompt: /colorize
codes.description: Gives a black-and-white photo its colours.
codes.note: Only a faint sepia tone. Add a sentence describing the colours you expect — and remember that colour added to an old photo is an interpretation, not evidence.
